topic: seven bangladeshis die in saudi road accident
headline: 7 Bangladeshis killed in Saudi road crash
summary: Six members of two families from Cox's Bazar were among the deceased in a tragic accident while returning to Jeddah from Madina.
details: Seven Bangladeshis, including six members of two families, were killed and six others injured when their vehicle overturned in Saudi Arabia early yesterday.
The accident occurred around 2:00 am in the Al-Himna area while the passengers, all from Cox's Bazar, were returning from Madina to Jeddah.
A preliminary report from the Bangladesh Consulate General in Jeddah suggests the vehicle, driven by a Pakistani national, was traveling at an estimated 160 km per hour.
While traffic officials suspect excessive speed caused the driver to lose control, the driver claims a tyre burst led to the accident.
Among the deceased were Ziaur Rahman and his three children—daughter Bushra and sons Yasir and Yazan—while his wife, Shakira, and daughter Yusra survived.
In another family, Sanjida and her daughter Faria were killed, while her husband Alam Shah and son Faisal were injured.
Afsana Bibi, who had arrived in Saudi Arabia just a few days prior to perform Umrah, was also among the victims.
The bodies of the victims are currently being kept at Al-Himna General Hospital and Kholais General Hospital.
caption:

A preliminary report from the Bangladesh Consulate General in Jeddah suggests the vehicle, driven by a Pakistani national, was traveling at an estimated 160 km per hour.

While traffic officials suspect excessive speed caused the driver to lose control, the driver claims a tyre burst led to the accident.

Among the deceased were Ziaur Rahman and his three children—daughter Bushra and sons Yasir and Yazan—while his wife, Shakira, and daughter Yusra survived.

In another family, Sanjida and her daughter Faria were killed, while her husband Alam Shah and son Faisal were injured.

Afsana Bibi, who had arrived in Saudi Arabia just a few days prior to perform Umrah, was also among the victims.

The bodies of the victims are currently being kept at Al-Himna General Hospital and Kholais General Hospital.

headline: 1,674 hospitalised as three more die of dengue in 24 hours
summary: The total death toll from dengue has risen to 458, with over 1.47 lakh cumulative cases reported across Bangladesh.
details: At least three dengue patients died and 1,674 others were hospitalised in a 24-hour period, according to the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS).
Of the recent deaths, two occurred in the Dhaka division and one was reported in the Barishal division.
The total death toll from the virus has now climbed to 458, while the cumulative number of cases has reached 1,47,580.
Currently, 5,826 dengue patients are undergoing treatment in hospitals across the country.
caption:
Three more lives lost and over 1,600 hospitalisations in just 24 hours. Dengue continues to surge across Bangladesh.

At least three dengue patients died and 1,674 others were hospitalised in a 24-hour period, according to the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS).

Of the recent deaths, two occurred in the Dhaka division and one was reported in the Barishal division.

The total death toll from the virus has now climbed to 458, while the cumulative number of cases has reached 1,47,580.

Currently, 5,826 dengue patients are undergoing treatment in hospitals across the country.
